descriptions.w3d_card_guide_message_by_encoding: Memory-card guide: selects message 178 when the card's sector size is 8 KiB (0x2000), otherwise message -18.
descriptions.w3d_card_guide_message_damaged: Memory-card guide: chooses the damaged-card message for the current card status; panics on an unknown status.
